description: Trigger: admin.rs /peers/<addr>/ping URL-decodes the path segment and passes it directly to TcpStream::connect. Any caller with access to the admin port (loopback by default, but externally reachable if admin.addr is overridden) can direct the daemon to make TCP connections to arbitrary hosts:ports. Bad behavior: SSRF — allows an attacker with admin access to probe internal network services, bypass firewall rules, or cause resource exhaustion via connection attempts to slow hosts.
title: SSRF via /peers/<addr>/ping admin endpoint
